#GoProMISSION1 PRO ILS is now available 📦💨 This is not an action camera, this is a compact cinema camera with a Micro Four Thirds (MFT) lens mount, featuring dramatic depth of field, industry-leading frame rates and resolutions, a new 1-inch Quad Bayer sensor capable of 8K60, 4K240, 1080p960, 8K Open Gate capture, and more.

Nothing on the market rivals this level of affordability, versatility, and performance. Learn more and order yours at GoPro.com/ILS.
